sources.title: Molecular architecture of the prolate head of bacteriophage T4
sources.authors: Fokine A, Chipman PR, Leiman PG, Mesyanzhinov VV, Rao VB, Rossmann MG
sources.note: Head length 1,195 Å along the fivefold axis and width 860 Å; T_end = 13 laevo, T_mid = 20.

sources.title: Bacteriophage T4 head: structure, assembly, and genome packaging
sources.authors: Rao VB, Fokine A, Fang Q, Shao Q
sources.note: 120 × 86 nm prolate capsid; ~140 nm contractile tail; six ~160 nm kinked tail fibres; ~171 kb packaged linear dsDNA (2–3% more than unit length).

sources.title: Morphogenesis of the T4 tail and tail fibers
sources.authors: Leiman PG, Arisaka F, van Raaij MJ, Kostyuchenko VA, Aksyuk AA, Kanamaru S, Rossmann MG
sources.note: Tail = sheath, internal tube and baseplate; long and short tail fibres recognise the host; tail is the channel for DNA delivery into the host cytoplasm.
